items.summary_zh: 未經授權遠端安裝惡意程式碼。
items.fix_hint: 升級至最新版本或停用該插件。
items.desc_en: Joomla Extension - lomart.fr - Unauthenticated remote code installation in UP plugin extension 5.0.0-5.2.0, 6.0.0-6.0.29

items.summary_zh: 路徑驗證缺失導致提升至集群管理員。
items.fix_hint: 升級至 Kyverno 1.19.1 或更高版本。
items.desc_en: kyverno before 1.19.1 fails to properly validate URL-encoded path segments in Policy apiCall urlPath, allowing namespace tenants to bypass the per-namespace clamp and create objects in other namespaces as the admission-controller ServiceAccount. Attackers can exploit this by using percent-encoded directory traversal sequences to create MutatingWebhookConfiguration objects cluster-wide or PolicyException objects in the kyverno namespace, enabling privilege escalation to cluster admin.

items.summary_zh: 符號連結攻擊導致獲取主機根權限。
items.fix_hint: 升級至 Froxlor 2.3.12 或更高版本。
items.desc_en: Froxlor is a server administration panel. items.summary_zh: CRLF 注入導致竄改伺服器配置。
items.fix_hint: 升級至 Froxlor 2.3.12 或更高版本。
items.desc_en: froxlor is a server administration panel. In versions 2.3.10 and earlier, Validate::validateUrl rejects carriage return and line feed characters only in the path, query and fragment components returned by parse_url, and never inspects the userinfo (user:pass@) components. This is an incomplete fix for GHSA-c3p2. items.summary_zh: L2TP 處理越界寫入導致遠端代碼執行。
items.fix_hint: 更新韌體或限制 L2TP 服務存取。
items.desc_en: A vulnerability was detected in D-Link DIR-895L A1_102b07. Impacted is the function tunnel_set_params of the file tunnel.c of the component L2TP Control Channel Parser. Performing a manipulation results in out-of-bounds write. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.
